title: UAP moving at Mach 40 explained as larger observer matrices

tellings.quote: So this is when we get to the UAP kind of stuff where, right, you

plain: An unexplained object seen moving at about forty times the speed of sound could be understood through what the cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman calls larger observer matrices, part of his theory that consciousness, not space and time, is what is fundamental. In the passage itself Hoffman only says this is where his ideas reach "the UAP kind of stuff", UAP being the government's term for UFOs. The idea is that such impossible speeds may not be travel through space at all.
